detail.longDescription: I'm having issues with the following piece of code I rewrote based on this code on CodePen . None of the images are showing when I run index.html. I added different image sources leading to .png files saved in the same folder as index.html and sketch.js (e.g. p1.png). I'm getting issues at src.appendChild(img) , but can't see what the problem is because I get the no debugger available error. Moving the script src to the end of the document fixes the main issue. // sketch.js: function displayFour() { let images = [ "p1.png", "p2.png", "p3.png", "p4.png", "p5.png" ] let selectedIndices = [] while (selectedIndices.length < 4) { let index = images[Math.floor(Math.random() * images.length)] if (selectedIndices.indexOf(index) == -1) { selectedIndices.push(index) } } for (i = 0; i < selectedIndices.length; i++) { let img = document.createElement("img"); img.src = selectedIndices[i] img.className = "image" let src = document.getElementById("images"); src.appendChild(img); } } displayFour() #images { display: flex; gap: 1em; }
